_comment: Fixed script for the Phase 8 side-quest A/B test (local vs cloud primary model). Deliberately avoids any phrasing that would trigger the Phase 8 cloud-escalation tools (research_topic / plan_upcoming_week / summarize_past_week) — those call Anthropic directly regardless of which model is primary, which would make both runs look identical on those turns and defeat the comparison.
turns: What's a safe way to defrost chicken quickly without a microwave?
In one paragraph, explain the difference between TCP and UDP.
What's on my calendar for the next 7 days?
Add oat milk and paper towels to the grocery list.
I have a friend visiting this weekend who's vegetarian and gluten-free — suggest a simple dinner menu for two nights.
Someone in the family keeps leaving the porch light on overnight — draft a short, friendly note to the group about it.
What's currently on the grocery list?
